title: ModuleContext
description: Root props of one module surface. Set natively on that surface only; lifecycle and appearance updates arrive as new props on the same surface (per-surface routing), never via a broadcast to the shared JS context. No credential-shaped keys or values are permitted.

environment.description: Semantic appearance snapshot (see ModuleEnvironment in src/index.ts).

userID.description: Null unless the manifest declares, and policy grants, `identity.userID`.

signedIn.description: Whether a shell account is signed in. Non-identifying.
